size.description: Image resolution. Standard mode supports 1K and 2K. Layer decomposition mode supports 1K, 1.5K, 2K, and auto; auto sizes the base image and layers from the input image.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Text prompt. In standard mode, describes the image to generate. In layer decomposition mode it is optional: describe which elements to split out, or leave blank to auto-detect all major elements. Maximum 4000 characters.

image_input.title: Image Input
image_input.description: Input image(s). In standard mode, 1-10 reference images for image-to-image generation. In layer decomposition mode, exactly one image to decompose.

aspect_ratio.description: Image aspect ratio (ignored in layer decomposition mode). Use 'match_input_image' to automatically match the input image's aspect ratio.

output_format.description: Output image format. In layer decomposition mode this only controls the base image; layers are always returned as PNG.

layer_decomposition.title: Layer Decomposition
layer_decomposition.description: Split a single input image into a base image plus separate element layers (up to 16). Requires exactly one input image. Each returned layer includes its stacking order, bounding box, name, and description.
